items.briefing:
A critical vulnerability in GitLab requires attention from any organisation using that platform to manage code or projects — attackers can exploit it without any user interaction, making patching urgent. Separately, a cyberattack technique called "CoSnitch" has demonstrated how Microsoft Copilot can be manipulated into revealing an organisation's internal IT structure, a reminder to review what AI tools can access. The "TwinLoot" threat is also worth noting — it operates entirely within Microsoft's cloud infrastructure, meaning traditional security tools may not detect it.

Ransomware payments remain a growing concern for Australian organisations, with Troy Hunt's latest update highlighting ongoing pressure on businesses to pay cyber ransoms. If your organisation uses GitLab, check with your IT team today to confirm updates have been applied. **Practical tip:** Review what data and systems your AI tools (like Copilot) can access — limit permissions to only what staff genuinely need.

featured.title: Critical GitLab Zero-Click Flaw Poses Mitigation Challenges
